note: Dated observations, not constants. An adapter reads its flags from the entry matching the probed version; an unknown version falls back to the newest entry and the probe says so. Each block says how it was established: `observed` (seen in a live run on the date), `help` (read from --help only, never exercised), `tested` (the adapter's own unit tests).

claude-cli.platform: win32 (Windows 11), native claude.exe, started from inside another Claude Code session (CLAUDECODE and CLAUDE_CODE_* inherited untouched)
claude-cli.method: claude --help; claude auth status --json; four live runs through this adapter (generate with a schema, edit, edit with a 1 s timeout, Designer generate). Reduced envelopes: fixtures/envelopes/. WP3b (same day): one image probe, two edit-mode permission preflights (scripts/live-preflight.mjs), the first live Planner call, and the builder runs of the job site/marble-run-three-marbles-20261110-1.

promptChannel.how: stdin with -p and --input-format text; never argv

outputFormats.noiseOnStdout: none seen (0 non-JSON lines in 4 runs); stderr empty

schema.behaviour: the CLI adds one tool named StructuredOutput even with --tools ""; the run takes 2 turns and the result's stop_reason is "tool_use", not "end_turn"; `result` holds the same JSON as text

toolRestriction.toolSet: --tools ("" disables all built-in tools; init then lists only StructuredOutput when a schema is given)
toolRestriction.editObserved: --restricted --permission-mode acceptEdits --tools Read,Glob,Grep,Edit,Write: init tools were exactly [Edit, Glob, Grep, Read, Write], permissionMode acceptEdits, a Write inside cwd succeeded without a prompt, the model reported having no shell tool, permission_denials was empty
toolRestriction.allowDeny: permissions.allow and permissions.deny in a per-call --settings file (accepted by the CLI together with --safe-mode and --restricted)
notExercised: a write outside cwd and outside every --add-dir directory being refused by --restricted
readonly-scan mode (--restricted --tools Read,Glob,Grep): not needed, the critic takes its images in generate mode
toolRestriction.unattended: --permission-prompts none (anything that would prompt is denied)
toolRestriction.customizationsOff: --safe-mode: mcp_servers was 0 and the first-turn context was about 2.7k tokens in generate mode; init still listed built-in agents, skills and plugins, so `off` means user customizations, not built-ins
toolRestriction.enforcementClass: policy inside the CLI, not an operating-system sandbox
toolRestriction.addDir: --restricted confines the file tools to cwd plus --add-dir directories (help). The Foreman passes one --add-dir per reference directory (a copy of API.md and example packs inside the job directory, never the engine itself).
toolRestriction.bashAllowObserved: 2026-11-10, edit mode, --restricted --permission-mode acceptEdits --permission-prompts none --tools Read,Glob,Grep,Edit,Write,Bash with permissions.allow = ["Bash(<godot> --headless --path <engine> res://kernel/host/host.tscn -- lint:*)"] in the per-call --settings file: the granted runner call ran from the builder's shell; the same runner with another verb (-- smoke) was DENIED; `env | grep -c ...` was DENIED; `curl --version` was DENIED (deny rule); a refusal comes back at once as a tool error and is listed in the result's permission_denials (no hang). `echo hello` and `node --version` RAN without a grant: the CLI lets a class of harmless read-only commands through by itself, so the allowlist is not the whole truth about the shell.
toolRestriction.addDirObserved: 2026-11-10: with --add-dir <dir> the Read tool reads files there, and the Write tool WRITES there too in acceptEdits mode (not refused). So a directory given to a builder for reference is writable by it: the Foreman gives a copy (<job>/ref), hashes it around every run, records a change and restores it.

ceilings.wallClock: none offered by the CLI: the Foreman's timeoutMs with a process-tree kill (taskkill /T /F) is the only wall clock. Observed: a 1000 ms timeout ended the run at 1.2 s with only the init event received and no process left behind.
ceilings.turns: no --max-turns in --help of this version; the result carries num_turns and terminal_reason ("completed" seen)
ceilings.idle: unknown: no run was long enough to meet one

auth.billingFlipStatus: help and documentation only: no key was set in this environment, so the flip itself was not observed
auth.childReport: apiKeySource in the init event; "none" observed on a claude.ai subscription login

environment.rule: edit and readonly-scan runs: variables whose names contain KEY, TOKEN, SECRET or PASSWORD are removed from the child environment, except ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN and CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN (the adapter's own authentication). The subscription login is not in the environment, so nothing is lost.
environment.status: tested (unit); observed live in the WP3b job

tokenUsage.resultField: the final result event: usage.input_tokens, usage.cache_creation_input_tokens, usage.cache_read_input_tokens, usage.output_tokens
tokenUsage.cacheReads: usage.cache_read_input_tokens of the result event carries the cache reads (also present per assistant message in message.usage). The adapter reports tokensIn = input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens + cache_read_input_tokens and, since WP3c, tokensCacheRead = cache_read_input_tokens; the Foreman logs both raw and counts cache reads at weight 0.1 against a token policy.
